roles.name: Architecture critic
roles.objective: Find architectural contradictions, unnecessary layers, missing boundaries, and simpler stronger alternatives.

roles.name: Formal methods reviewer
roles.objective: Find underspecified semantics, unverifiable claims, type/contract gaps, and proof-obligation failures.

roles.name: Adversarial red-team reviewer
roles.objective: Try to break the design with concrete counterexamples, bypasses, stale-state failures, and compositional failures.

roles.name: Current AI research reviewer
roles.objective: Check the section against current AI systems research and identify obsolete assumptions or genuinely missing capabilities.

roles.name: Human sovereignty and rights reviewer
roles.objective: Stress-test consent, minority rights, coercion, appeal, paternalism, and authority boundaries.

roles.name: Privacy reviewer
roles.objective: Stress-test inference privacy, mental privacy, provenance, data minimization, and cross-agent leakage.

roles.name: Distributed systems reviewer
roles.objective: Check consistency, partial failure, stale state, Byzantine behavior, identity continuity, and distributed authorization.

roles.name: Implementation engineer
roles.objective: Identify what cannot yet be implemented deterministically and propose the smallest executable contract.

roles.name: Physical systems and control reviewer
roles.objective: Check embodied, transport, control, timing, uncertainty, and safe-fallback assumptions.

roles.name: Scientific epistemics reviewer
roles.objective: Check evidence ladders, falsifiability, causal inference, replication, uncertainty, and theory lifecycle.

roles.name: Complexity eliminator
roles.objective: Find redundant concepts, duplicate mechanisms, and places where fewer primitives preserve the same guarantees.

roles.name: Cross-section integrator
roles.objective: Detect cross-document conflicts and propagate accepted changes across dependencies without semantic loss.
